checkpoints.mandatory: cgroup current/peak/events/stat and process RSS/HWM; Arrow default pool live bytes with known backend; source/provenance/role mapping; no missing required checkpoint success
checkpoints.optional: smaps_rollup/allocatedblocks/Arrow pool peak may be unknown with explicit reason; missing supporting fields limit interpretation, never impute zero
required_fields: Arrow default-pool live bytes/backend and nullable high-water
nullable allocated-block count and smaps-rollup with reasons
O(1) row/matrix metadata only where available

cleanup.failure: Preserve partial raw, original exception and cleanup errors, verify protected sources when possible; any missing cleanup/provenance => invalid/incomplete, spent allowance
cleanup.global_deadline_policy: All stage limits are ceilings, not additive entitlements. Host monotonic deadline is wall3600 minus outer margin120; native wait ceiling min(3030,remaining minus host-post reserve240). Runtime total/stage waits also clamp to remaining host allocation and preserve600 cleanup; no deadline extends Slurm wall.
cleanup.hooks: Disable monitoring before original callback restoration/free; keep minimal owned rollback/close accounting through teardown, restore all driver/bindings before final guest/host locks
cleanup.mandatory_teardown_delegation: Observer failure at close/rollback must not suppress the saved original teardown: capture invalidity, delegate mandatory cleanup once through reserved minimal lane without heavy probes, then preserve primary/cleanup errors. If exact accounting cannot be recovered the result is invalid/incomplete; no success or resumed acquisition.
cleanup.readers: Close all readers and admin connections; rollback/close only through bounded failure path, no retry/new query
cleanup.servers: Stop only two owned working servers, verify no postmaster.pid and clean control/graph state; retained sources never started
cleanup.snapshots: Preserve shared snapshot roots/lifetime; do not clear or GC as diagnostic intervention

diagnostic_limits.process_or_cgroup_read_roots: Only mapped owned processes and three validated job/step-user/task scopes; existing sampler still covers all observed ancestors
diagnostic_limits.wall_charge_definition: Observer bookkeeping/probe IO/logging/setup/restoration only, excluding unchanged delegated operation duration; nested observers charged once. Original elapsed command intervals separately include delegation; all host/runtime/stage deadlines include every cost without subtraction.

driver_accounting.api_meaning: Original charged explicit API statements unchanged; exactly one lower execution link per completed API call; named DATA API maps to actual DECLARE dispatch
driver_accounting.ownership: Two exact owned sockets/datadirs; two admins+ten original readers; bounded pending connect capability before dispatch, no external/unknown connection
driver_accounting.physical_scope: Observed Python driver command dispatch attempts/completions/errors; not packet-level accounting
driver_accounting.recording: Unique monotonic attempt IDs reserved before dispatch; completion/error matched, bounded buffered rows; no raw SQL params/vector/credential payloads; complete flush required for positive diagnostic result; hard-kill prefix may undercount pending work and cannot qualify
driver_accounting.validation: Exact generated cursor names/pass ids and FETCH FORWARD100; BEGIN/COMMIT only in four original verification scopes; ROLLBACK only existing failure cleanup; driver deallocation only registered owned names; no nested/savepoint/pipeline/COPY/stream/DDL/search/EXPLAIN/extra data SQL

excluded: per-element/object-graph walk or full allocation trace

expected_runtime_libraries.libpq: Record actual version/capabilities and source route in pinned image; no host substitution
expected_runtime_libraries.python: CPython3.12.15 in pinned image; no upgrade to documentation patch version

gates: A2.0 actual runtime capability/provenance before restore
A3 informative/unresolved decision and separate remedy design; resource margin reviewed separately

family_conditions.constructor_validation_bracket: Material observed RSS/HWM/pool excursion between matrix-before/matrix-ready or finite/norm boundary points, valid source order and exact matrix metadata; masked high-water or unobserved short C temporary remains unknown.
family_conditions.cursor_decode_transient: Material RSS/HWM or anonymous excursion after existing result receipt before decode, or material observed RSS and/or anonymous decrease across original tracked cursor close with full row/count proof and unchanged semantics; report distinct measurements, not causal allocation bytes.
family_conditions.file_charge_operation_coincidence: Material observed file-charge delta inside a newly isolated original IO role while absolute anonymous and process-RSS deltas are each below256MiB, complete role coverage and known/unknown logical byte fields; correlation only, no per-file ownership/reclaimability proof.
family_conditions.retained_snapshot_context: Same shared aliases/counts/matrix metadata through both epochs and final reader close; descriptive residence/stability control only and cannot alone qualify informative outcome.
family_conditions.verification_default_pool_overlap: Material default-pool live/peak variation in exact pass/fetch/checkpoint context with corresponding process observation and full rows; no attribution to all Arrow/native memory.

interpretation.futility: Masked high-water, short-lived C temporary, unavailable supporting counters or broad IO role may leave unresolved; no more probes/repeat/remedy automatically
interpretation.required_for_informative: All integrity/accounting/checkpoint/overhead/cleanup gates pass, plus at least one new prespecified discriminating cursor/constructor/pool/file-role bracket fact >=256MiB with its consistency conditions. Reconfirming shared retention/capped peak or closing driver counters alone is insufficient; no exact object/file causality follows.
interpretation.threshold_meaning: Descriptive triage only, not acceptance margin/confidence/saving or causal object size

io_roles.bytes: Existing inventory/copy/verification return metadata and bounded stat/manifest metadata only; deepest role owns bytes, parent totals are references not additive duplicates; unavailable byte quantities explicitly unknown; no extra content/hash pass
io_roles.not_measured: Cgroup page ownership, physical IO by file and all filesystem/cache allocations

monitoring.disable_policy: Return DISABLE for each visited source location after handling/coalescing it; no restart_events, no global events, no source rewrite or replacement constructor
monitoring.events: LINE locally on two original code objects only
monitoring.preexisting_monitor_or_trace: Any occupied tool0..5, nonzero monitoring events, existing sys trace/profile or concurrent Python snapshot thread => capability stop; no tool stealing
monitoring.restore: Clear local/global masks, unregister LINE callback, then free tool id; original producer/constructor/digest and monitoring state must be restored before publication. Declared driver hooks remain only through owned connection teardown and are restored before final locks; finally handles BaseException/signals.
monitoring.source_mapping: Verify frozen source SHA, exact function/AST statement and line table; LINE callback validates frame code, takes only scalar/O(1) metadata, never retains frames/locals/rows/matrix

question: Which existing snapshot/verification lifetime brackets and command/IO roles explain observed pressure sufficiently to choose one future remedy?

unchanged_resource_decision.comparison: max(cgroup aggregate recorded peak over all visible finite ancestors)+reserve+workspace <= min(32GiB,all visible finite memory limits)
unchanged_resource_decision.event_policy: No positive oom/oom_kill/oom_group_kill/max/failcnt delta for a margin pass; missing counters/peak/gaps=>inconclusive
unchanged_resource_decision.scope: startup/admission resource readiness only; no workload memory, quality, A/A or performance qualification
